moments.text: Infrared sensor view of a grey sky, lighter toward the top. A tiny bright dot drifts around close to the crosshair.
A lighter hazy band spreads down over the crosshair; the tiny dot stays nearby, ending just below and right of the crosshair.
The picture flickers black and white for about half a second.
Wider view: bright upper area and darker lower area split by a horizontal line; corner brackets mark a smaller box around the crosshair.
The image breaks into blocks and flashes white, then returns to the closer view with the hazy band.
Another flicker: a ring pattern, white, black, then grey stripes.
A steady new view to the end: bright top, darker below, and a blurred grey diagonal shape in the upper right corner.
